steps.code:
import re

# Get the list of files (already obtained)
files = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=login_response['access_token'], directory_path='~/documents/work/meetings_data/', entry_type='files')

# Process each file
for file_path in files:
    # Extract basename
    basename = file_path.split('/')[-1]
    # Split on '__' to get date and rest
    parts = basename.split('__')
    if len(parts) != 2:
        continue  # skip if not in expected format
    date_str = parts[0]
    rest = parts[1]
    # Split on last '.' to get file_name and extension
    if '.' in rest:
        file_name, ext = rest.rsplit('.', 1)
    else:
        file_name = rest
        ext = ''
    # Create target directory: <file_name> inside meetings_data
    target_dir = f"~/documents/work/meetings_data/{file_name}"
    # Create directory if not exists (recursive not needed, but safe)
    apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=login_response['access_token'], directory_path=target_dir, recursive=True)
    # Destination file path: <file_name>/<date>.<ext>
    dest_path = f"{target_dir}/{date_str}.{ext}"
    # Move the file
    move_resp = apis.file_system.move_file(
        access_token=login_response['access_token'],
        source_file_path=file_path,
        destination_file_path=dest_path,
        overwrite=False
    )
    print(f"Moved {file_path} -> {dest_path}: {move_resp}")
